condition_types.price_below: value: breached when the price falls below this level
condition_types.stop_proximity_pct: value: breached when the price is within this percentage of stop_weekly_close in portfolio.json
condition_types.volume_ratio_20d: value: breached when today's volume exceeds this multiple of the 20-day average volume

MU.thesis_summary: Memory super-cycle / HBM leadership. The price sits well above the 50-day average (941.62 $, 25 Sep 2026) and the gap is widening; the Q4 earnings report on 30 September is the thesis's main test.

claims.text: HBM/DRAM demand is holding the price above the 50-day average (941.62 $); the 25 Sep close of 1082.28 $ is +14.9% above that average and the gap has widened for two rounds running.

Earnings (30 September 2026) are the thesis's two-sided test: the position is carried into the report because its stop distance (+48.3%) is the widest in the portfolio. A post-earnings price below 800 $ refutes the thesis.

AMD.thesis_summary: The NVDA alternative in AI accelerators. +24.9% above the 50-day average (504.71 $, 25 Sep 2026); RSI 73.0 puts it in overbought territory — the thesis is strong but short-term pullback risk is high.

claims.text: The NVDA-alternative thesis holds while the price stays above the 50-day average (504.71 $); slipping below that average would be a break signal after the momentum surge.
No adding to the position while RSI sits at 73.0 in overbought territory; a 10-15% pullback (around 550 $, a test of the 50-day average) would count as an entry opportunity.

ANET.thesis_summary: Leader in AI data-center network hardware; the steadiest position in the portfolio. +8.6% above the 50-day average (190.23 $, 25 Sep 2026).

claims.text: Network-hardware leadership holds while the price stays above the 50-day average (190.23 $); momentum has continued since the guidance raise. Losing that average puts the thesis in question.

NVDA.thesis_summary: AI accelerator leadership. A two-week recovery trend is intact, +4.3% above the 50-day average (215.79 $, 25 Sep 2026); the price is still 2.3% below the entry price (230.36 $).

claims.text: The two-week recovery trend continues above the 50-day average (215.79 $); losing that average and staying below it would mean the recovery has failed.
The position is held below its entry price (230.36 $) because the recovery trend has been confirmed for two rounds; a price below 200 $ refutes that reasoning and puts a trim on the table.
